exposure: Women with pre-gestational BMI < 25 kg/m2 and normal glucose tolerance (NGT)
Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra virgin olive oil and pistachios
outcome: Hospitalization due to other diseases requiring antibiotics
Hospitalization due to other diseases requiring corticosteroid treatment
cohort: 703 children born to mothers who participated in the St. Carlos gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) prevention study.
finding: Adherence to a Mediterranean diet during pregnancy was associated with a reduction in offspring's hospital admissions, especially in women with pre-gestational BMI < 25 kg/m2 and normal glucose tolerance.
